name: boe_daily
description: Read a specific BOE issue and filter item titles. Returns official identifiers and links, not an exhaustive search of legislation.

name: boe_document
description: Read the published BOE document XML and return text with provenance. Output truncation is explicit.

name: boe_consolidated
description: Read dated consolidated law blocks. Use returned block IDs for article-level retrieval; selection follows source version dates, not legal advice.

name: boe_compare
description: Compare one consolidated law block at two explicit dates. Returns a reproducible text diff and both version metadata.
